title: PC sales are continuing to slump - fewer are sold now than when the iPhone launched (AAPL, MSFT)
text: PC sales are continuing to slump — fewer are sold now than when the iPhone launched (AAPL, MSFT) By Zoë Bernard Jan 17, 2018, 6:13 pm 23 pts When Apple unveiled the iPhone in 2007, it was easy to dismiss notions that smartphones like it might eventually displace the almighty PC. At the time, PC sales were still booming, and the device was the center of computing. Not only could you not download apps to that first iPhone, you couldn't…
